params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Viktor}} collects ''Hex Fragments'' from enemies he kills and enemy champion {{tip|takedown|takedowns}}.
params.blurb2: At 100 ''Hex Fragments'', he gains an Augment to apply to any of his {{tip|abilities}}, empowering them with additional effects.
params.blurb3: ''{{ai|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' can be augmented after all of '''Viktor's''' basic abilities have been augmented.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Viktor''' can augment each of his {{tip|abilities}} at the cost of 100 ''Hex Fragments'', which he gains from killing enemies:
* {{tip|Minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} generate 1 ''Hex Fragment''.
* Siege minions, super minions, and epic monsters generate 10 ''Hex Fragments''.
* Enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} generate 20 ''Hex Fragments''.
params.description2: ''{{ai|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' can be augmented after all of '''Viktor's''' basic abilities have been augmented.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' throws a draining device at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} for 2 seconds and gains ''Discharge'' for 4 seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Discharge:}} '''Viktor's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Modified Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60+20 to 120+120}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+50}}% AP)}}}}

params.notes:
* ''Discharge'' does not convert the bonus damage dealt by {{tip|Spellblade}} to {{as|magic damage}} from {{as|physical|physical damage}}.{{bug}} <!--broke on V12.11-->

* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent '''Viktor''' from gaining ''Discharge''.
* Only the initial projectile can be {{tip|projectile|intercepted}}.
* The empowered attack will trigger against turrets but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|wards}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' deploys a gravity field at the target location for {{fd|4.5}} seconds. After a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, it activates to {{tip|slow}} enemies within for 1 second, refreshing every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while they remain inside.
params.description2: The field applies a {{tip|stack}} of ''Heavy Gravity'' to enemies within every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, stacking up to 5 times. The fifth stack consumes them all to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The knockdown and stun can be triggered only once per cast per enemy.
params.description3: {{Anchor|Augment: Magnetize}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Magnetize}} — }} '''Viktor's''' other abilities, excluding ''{{ais|Arcane Storm|Viktor}}'' persistent damage, {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 20% for 1 second.
params.notes:
* ''Gravity Field'' applies a single debuff for both the slow and the stack.
** Targets can be applied further stacks after having their stacks consumed for the first time.
*** Stacks are always consumed upon the fifth stack, but only the first instance of stacks being consumed can trigger the crowd control effects.
** The debuff lasts for 1 second.
* ''Gravity Field'' will remain active if '''Viktor''' dies.
* ''Gravity Field's'' animation can be seen by both teams through {{tip|Sight|fog of war}}.
* If an enemy enters the area of effect while {{tip|untargetable}}, they may generate stacks even after becoming stunned once, causing them to get stunned up-to 3 times by a single ''Gravity Field''.{{bug}} <!-- Bugged since precisely 11.1-->
<!-- Blurb -->

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Heavy Gravity:}} The fifth stack will consume them all to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and briefly {{tip|stun}} the target.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' fires an energy beam along the target path that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area.
params.description2: {{Anchor|Augment: Aftershock}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Aftershock}} — }} The path explodes along the beam's wake after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 140}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70+20 to 230+140}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Viktor''' may freely act while the ray is traveling.
** The effected area is set upon casting, no matter how far away '''Viktor''' moves. Unlike a leash, ''Hextech Ray'' will not break off its own effect.
* The laser grants a moderate area of {{tip|sight}} around where the beam strikes the ground.
* If ''Hextech Ray'' is {{tip|projectile|intercepted}}, the initial ray is not destroyed.
** However, the capability to be blocked only applies to the laser as it hits the ground. '''Viktor''' can cast the ability ''over'' the wall and it will not be destroyed or intercepted. 
** ''Augmented Hextech Ray'' will still cause the entire target area to explode even if the laser is blocked.
* If '''Viktor''' dies while he is firing the beam it only deals damage up to the location at the time of his death.
<!-- Blurb -->

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Viktor''' conjures an arcane singularity at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|disrupt|disrupting}} their {{tip|channel|channeled abilities}}.
params.description2: The singularity then remains active as a moving storm for {{fd|6.5}} seconds, striking a bolt of electricity onto enemies within it every second to deal {{as|magic damage}}, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area within its radius and the {{tt|surrounding area|If radius is below 700 units}}. The singularity will target the nearest champion hit by its initial damage and will follow them. The singularity moves faster based on its proximity to '''Viktor'''.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|100+65*6 to 250+145*6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+35*6}}% AP)}}}}
params.description3: ''Arcane Storm'' can be recast at any time while the singularity is active.
params.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Viktor''' directs the singularity to the target location, or to follow the target enemy champion or himself for its remaining duration.
params.description5: {{Anchor|Augment: Perfect Storm}}{{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment: Perfect Storm}} — }} The singularity moves 25% faster. Additionally, whenever an enemy champion is {{tip|takedown|taken down}} after being damaged by ''Arcane Storm'', the storm's size is increased by 40% and its duration is extended by 3 seconds. The storm's radius can be increased up to 6 times and the duration can be extended only up to the original duration.
params.description6: ''Arcane Storm's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
params.custominfo2: {{tip|Sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|700|Standard sight radius}} or {{tt|Storm radius|If the radius of the storm is above 700 units (for Perfect Storm)}}
params.custominfo3: {{pp|200 to 300|900 to 300 by 50|label=Speed|label1=Distance|showtype=false|formula=NON-AUGMENTED — Maximum speed of 300 achieved at or below 300 units away from Viktor; minimum speed of 200 achieved at or above 900 units from Viktor. Then, linearly interpolate.}}
params.custominfo4: {{pp|200*1.25 to 300*1.25|900 to 300 by 50|label=Speed|label1=Distance|showtype=false|formula=PERFECT STORM — Maximum speed of 200 × 125% achieved at or below 300 units away from Viktor; minimum speed of 300 × 125% achieved at or above 900 units from Viktor. Then, linearly interpolate.}}
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
* '''Viktor''' can command the singularity regardless of how far away he is from it.
* The singularity will remain active even if '''Viktor''' dies and will automatically follow the nearest enemy champion in range at the time of his death, if it wasn't locked on already.
** The singularity will only be issued to automatically follow a nearby champion once; it will not lock on to a new target if its current target becomes invalid.
** Any commands it was issued prior to his death will not be interrupted.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the initial damage.
* If ''Perfect Storm's'' singularity scores the killing blow on an enemy champion with the initial damage, it will spawn with the increased size.
** If multiple champions are dealt the killing blow by the initial hit, the singularity will spawn with the increased size respective to the number of champions killed.
* The base duration allows for 7 strikes (including the initial one).
* The storm will follow its target even if they are not {{tip|sight|visible}}, effectively giving away their position.
* ''Arcane Storm'' is not obstructed by terrain.
* The {{tip|disrupt}} is 'wrapped' into a status effect that causes affected champions to display the "{{tip|silence|Silenced}}" UI on their [[Health bar#Disabled state|health bar]] for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, without actually applying the disabling effects of the {{tip|silence}} crowd control type (functions as an indicator of the target becoming ''disrupted''). This however ensures that the ''disrupt'' is also prevented by effects that would negate {{tip|silence|silences}} (such as {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}).
* After becoming augmented, an [[File:Viktor Arcane Storm 3.png|20px|border]] alternate icon is used for the recast of ''Arcane Storm''.
* The champion that ''Arcane Storm'' is following will have an overhead indicator.
<!-- Blurb -->

The singularity then remains for a duration, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area. If the initial hit has struck at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, it will automatically follow the nearest one hit.
params.blurb2: ''Arcane Storm'' can be recast at any time while the singularity is active.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Viktor''' directs the singularity to the target location or to follow the targeted enemy champion.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Glorious Evolution|Viktor|Augment}}:}} The singularity moves faster. Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} (up to 6) after the storm damages them will increase the singularity's size and duration.
